rationale: C02 plausibly supplied a material drafting template for the child. Both directives first require executive agencies to cooperate and furnish information or personnel services, then separately compel government personnel, upon request, to testify and provide documents or other information. That paired sequence and investigative machinery are substantially more distinctive than a generic cooperation clause. C08 and C13 also closely parallel the child's cooperation, emergency-fund financing, and temporary-body provisions, but neither contains C02's especially probative testimony-and-document mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies are authorized and directed to cooperate fully... to furnish him... such information, personnel, and other assistance, including papers, records, and documents, as he may require
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies... are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Committee... and to furnish the Committee such information or the services of such persons as the Committee may require
shared_material.explanation: Closely parallel agency-wide cooperation and compelled provision of information and personnel services.

shared_material.child_excerpt: When requested... persons employed in the executive branch... shall give such testimony and shall submit to such examinations... as the said Special Assistant... may require
shared_material.parent_excerpt: When requested by the Committee to do so, persons in the armed services or in any of the executive departments and agencies... shall testify before the committee and shall make available... such documents and other information as the Committee may require
shared_material.explanation: A distinctive follow-on provision compelling personnel testimony and evidentiary production upon the investigator's request.

shared_material.child_excerpt: SEC. 1... cooperate... furnish... information, personnel... papers, records, and documents... SEC. 3. When requested... persons... shall give such testimony
shared_material.parent_excerpt: 4. All executive departments and agencies... cooperate... furnish... information or the services of such persons... 5. When requested... persons... shall testify... and shall make available... documents and other information
shared_material.explanation: The same operative sequence separates agency cooperation and resource production from individual testimony and document production.
